workspace.app.yaml:
applicationProfile:
  metadata:
    type: "native"
    schemaVersion: "1.1.0"
    name: "web-frontend"
    version: "1.0.0"
    description: "Nginx web server."
    owner: "HyperAI-User"
    lifecyclePhase: "development"
  specs:
    runtime:
      executionType: "container"
      entryPoint: "nginx"
      args: []
      baseOS:
        name: "debian"
        version: "bookworm-slim"
      containerImage:
        uri: "nginx"
        tag: "latest"
    resources:
      cpu: "500m"
      memory: "512Mi"
      storage: "1Gi"
    network:
      ports:
        - port: 80
          protocol: "TCP"
          publicExposure: true
      protocols: ["HTTP"]
    constraints:
      supportedArchitectures: ["x86_64", "arm64"]
